text: One of My Prettiest Comforter Sets. Bought this several years ago, and still remains one of my favorite that I ever had.

product_metadata.title: Madison Park Scarlett 100% Cotton Comforter Set-Modern Cottage Design All Season Down Alternative Bedding, Matching Shams, Bedskirt, Decorative Pillows, King, Blue 6 Piece
features: Cotton Comforter Set offers a shabby chic update to your bedroom decor.
A paisley print is featured on the cotton comforter with pintucked fabric separated by lace taping embellishments.
Naturally breathable and lightweight cotton fabric paired with a polly fill will bring you year round comfort.
Set includes: 1 Comforter: 104"W x 92"L, 2 King Shams: 20"W x 36"L, 1 Bedskirt: 78"W x 80"L+ 15"D, 1 Decorative Pillow: 12" W x 18"L, 1 Decorative Pillow: 18"W x 18"L
Care Instructions: Machine Washable. Pillow Spot Clean
